summary: Bed Bath & Beyond, Inc. acquired TwoPonds, Inc. (SFV Services) via merger of its wholly owned subsidiary for 7.2 million shares of common stock. No cash price, per-share value, or premium disclosed. Board approved; no advisors named. The buyer issued shares with registration rights on Form S-3 within 90 days, lock-up, and voting agreements. Post-closing, SFV Services becomes a wholly owned subsidiary. What to watch: future resale registration effectiveness and potential dilution impact.
